title: Personal Loan Apps List 2026: Top 10+ Best Apps in India
summary: Personal loan apps list for India 2026: top 10+ RBI-verified fintech, NBFC and bank apps with real rates, limits, hidden costs and safety checks.
body_markdown:
A useful personal loan apps list has to answer three things at once: which apps are genuinely safe, what each one actually lends, and what it really costs after fees. This list covers the top 10+ personal loan apps in India for 2026 in two groups, fintech and NBFC personal loan apps for speed, and major bank apps for the lowest rates, followed by the hidden costs, the RBI rules that protect you, and a two-minute safety check for any app not on this list.

All rates and limits are indicative at the time of writing; the exact offer always depends on your credit profile, income, and the lender's current terms.


## Top Fintech and NBFC Personal Loan Apps


These NBFC personal loan apps process everything digitally and often approve and disburse small to moderate amounts within minutes. Each one lends through an RBI-registered NBFC, which is the fact that separates a genuine[NBFC loan app list](https://gromo.in/blog/nbfc-loan-app-list/) from the dangerous corners of the loan app market.


### 1. Moneyview


Moneyview offers loans up to Rs 10 lakh with interest starting around 14 percent per year and tenures up to 60 months. Its own credit model considers moderate profiles that banks often decline, the segment covered in any[bad CIBIL loan app list](https://gromo.in/blog/bad-cibil-loan-app-list/) , making it one of the most widely usable apps on this list.


Lending is through Whizdm Finance, its RBI-registered NBFC.


### 2. KreditBee


KreditBee suits quick cash needs: Rs 1,000 up to Rs 5 lakh, with rates between roughly 17 and 30 percent per year depending on profile and tenure. Disbursal is fast and the entry barrier is low, which also means the smallest, fastest loans carry the highest rates on the range. Its lending NBFC is KrazyBee Services.


### 3. Navi Finserv


Navi handles the largest fintech tickets, up to Rs 20 lakh, with competitive rates starting near 10 percent per year for strong profiles. The process is fully digital inside the app, and Navi Finserv is itself an RBI-registered NBFC rather than a partner-dependent platform.


### 4. Fibe (Formerly EarlySalary)


Fibe is built for salaried borrowers: up to Rs 5 lakh disbursed almost instantly, with zero foreclosure charges, so you can close the loan early without penalty. Rates start around 18 percent per year, and salary-advance style short loans are its core strength.


### 5. CASHe


CASHe targets young salaried professionals and uses an alternate credit scoring model, so a thin CIBIL file matters less than your income and digital footprint. Loans go up to Rs 3 lakh through its NBFC, Bhanix Finance. Rates run higher than bank loans, so treat it as a short-tenure tool.


### 6. Stashfin


Stashfin's difference is structure: a revolving credit line up to Rs 5 lakh instead of a one-time loan. You draw what you need, pay interest on the used amount, and reuse the limit as you repay, which suits irregular or staged expenses better than a lump sum.


### 7. mPokket


mPokket serves college students and young professionals needing small amounts, typically Rs 500 to Rs 50,000, at around 2 to 3.5 percent per month. Small and fast cuts both ways: convenient in a pinch, expensive as a habit. Borrow the minimum and clear it fast.


## Major Institutional Bank Apps


If you already hold a salary or savings account with a large bank, its own app usually beats every fintech rate, and pre-approved offers disburse in one click with paperwork the bank already has.


### 8. SBI YONO


YONO's pre-approved personal loans start around 10 percent per year for amounts up to Rs 50 lakh for eligible customers. For SBI account holders, checking YONO before any fintech app is simply free money saved.


### 9. HDFC Bank MobileBanking


HDFC's app shows pre-approved loan offers for existing customers with flexible tenures and near-instant disbursal. Rates depend on your relationship and profile, and salaried customers with clean records get the sharpest offers.


### 10. ICICI iMobile Pay


ICICI's iMobile Pay processes instant, paperless personal loans up to Rs 50 lakh for prime borrowers. Existing customers see their eligible amount inside the app, and disbursal to the linked account takes minutes.


### 11. IDFC FIRST Bank App


IDFC FIRST offers end-to-end digital personal loans starting at 9.99 percent per year, among the lowest advertised starting rates, with clean in-app processing for both existing and new customers.


## Hidden Costs and Regulatory Guardrails


1. **Processing fees.** Expect 1.5 to 6 percent of the loan amount deducted upfront, plus GST. A Rs 1 lakh loan at a 3 percent fee credits only about Rs 96,460 to your account while interest runs on the full lakh.
2. **The real APR.** Once processing fees and any late penalties compound, fintech loan costs commonly land between 18 and 45 percent APR. Always read the Key Fact Statement, which lenders must show you, stating the all-inclusive APR before you accept.
3. **Privacy rules protect you.** Under the RBI's digital lending rules, verified loan apps cannot access your contact list, photo gallery, or call logs. An app demanding these permissions is announcing that it does not follow RBI rules; delete it immediately.
4. **Money flows directly.** RBI rules require disbursal straight from the lender's account to your bank account, with no third-party wallets in between, and clear disclosure of the lending NBFC's name.


## List of RBI Approved Loan Apps: How to Verify Any App


The RBI approves lenders, not apps, so a genuine list of[RBI approved loan apps](https://gromo.in/blog/rbi-approved-loan-apps/) really means apps whose lender is RBI-registered. Verify any app in two minutes:


1. Find the lender's name inside the app or on its website; genuine apps state their bank or NBFC partner clearly.
2. Check the app in the RBI's Digital Lending Apps (DLA) directory on the RBI website.
3. Match the NBFC's name in the RBI's register of NBFCs.
4. Read the Key Fact Statement for rate, fees, and APR before any money moves.
5. Walk away if the app demands an upfront fee, wants contacts or gallery access, or arrived as an APK link on WhatsApp or Telegram.


## A Caution on 7 Days Loan Apps


Searches for a[7 days loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/7-days-loan-apps-list/) spike every month, and that market is where most loan harassment cases begin. Ultra-short loans from unregistered apps carry crushing effective rates, and recovery tactics often involve the contact-list access the RBI has banned.


If you need genuinely short-term money, use the regulated options above with early closure (Fibe's zero foreclosure charges, Stashfin's credit line), and never an app that is not verifiable in the RBI's directory or that appears on any known[fake loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/fake-loan-apps-list/) .


## How to Choose From This List


1. **Bank app first.** If you hold an account with SBI, HDFC, ICICI, or IDFC FIRST, check its pre-approved offer before anything else; it is almost always the cheapest.
2. **Match the app to the amount.** Under Rs 50,000: mPokket or KreditBee. Mid-size: Moneyview, Fibe, CASHe. Large: Navi or a bank app.
3. **Compare APR, not headline rate.** The Key Fact Statement's all-in APR is the only honest comparison number.
4. **Borrow the need, not the limit,** and match the tenure to the purpose.
5. **Pay every EMI on time.** These loans report to credit bureaus, so each on-time EMI helps[improve your credit score](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-improve-credit-score-india-2026/) and each default damages it for years.

## FAQ: Personal Loan Apps List


**Which are the best personal loan apps in India?**


For large amounts at low rates: Navi, SBI YONO, ICICI iMobile Pay, and the IDFC FIRST Bank app. For fast mid-size loans: Moneyview, Fibe, and KreditBee.


For small amounts: mPokket for students and CASHe for young salaried borrowers. If you already bank with SBI, HDFC, ICICI, or IDFC FIRST, check your own bank's pre-approved offer first; it is usually the cheapest.


**Which personal loan apps are RBI approved in India?**


The RBI approves lenders, not apps, so the safe list is apps whose lender is RBI-registered: Moneyview (Whizdm Finance), KreditBee (KrazyBee Services), Navi Finserv, Fibe, CASHe (Bhanix Finance), Stashfin, mPokket, and every major bank app. Verify any app in the RBI's Digital Lending Apps directory and match its NBFC in the RBI register before borrowing.


**Are 7 days loan apps safe?**


Almost never. Ultra-short-term apps outside the RBI's directory carry crushing effective rates and are behind most loan harassment cases in India.


If you need short-term money, use a regulated app with early closure instead: Fibe charges zero foreclosure fees and Stashfin's credit line charges interest only on what you use.


**What are the hidden charges in personal loan apps?**


Processing fees of 1.5 to 6 percent plus GST are deducted upfront, so you receive less than you borrow while paying interest on the full amount. With fees and penalties compounded, fintech loan APRs commonly run 18 to 45 percent.


The Key Fact Statement every regulated lender must show states the all-inclusive APR; read it before accepting any offer.


**Can I get a personal loan app with a low CIBIL score?**


Yes. Moneyview and CASHe use their own credit models that weigh income and repayment capacity over a thin or weak CIBIL file, and mPokket serves students with no credit history at all. Expect higher rates for weaker profiles, borrow small, and repay on time; a few months of clean EMIs opens cheaper doors.


**How much loan can I get instantly from an app?**


Small-ticket apps disburse Rs 1,000 to Rs 50,000 within minutes, mid-size apps like Moneyview, Fibe, and KreditBee go up to Rs 5 to 10 lakh the same day for eligible profiles, and Navi and bank apps reach Rs 20 to 50 lakh for prime borrowers with pre-approved offers disbursing in one click.
